projects.heading: My first projects
projects.intro: Two simple projects showcasing my first steps building web experiences: a classic online store and a landing page.

items.title: Taller Biciclistas
items.summary: A web platform for bicycle services and retail, built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Supabase.
items.description: A web platform for a bicycle workshop, with an admin panel to manage the store, products, site content, and users. It supports workshop order management and gives each customer access to their service history, as well as marketing and password-reset emails. Features include Mercado Libre-referenced products, an online store with Mercado Pago payments, WhatsApp contact, and sign-in with Google OAuth or a custom registration form. Customers can download a PDF summary of their completed work. It also integrates Google Analytics 4, a Google reviews widget, and image management with Supabase Storage, including image compression and resizing on upload. The site includes optimized SEO and received an A+ rating on Security Headers.
